This is `docs/service_status.csv` rendered. That CSV is the source of truth: edit it, and a
change to any service's status shows up in a diff beside the code change that caused it. To
refresh the group's shared sheet from it, run `python3 docs/publish_service_status.py`.

```{python}
#| output: false
import os
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown

status = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath('__file__')),
                                  'service_status.csv'), encoding='utf-8-sig')
status = status.fillna('')


def section(frame, columns, widths):
    """One column-subset of the table as markdown, so a wide sheet reads on a page."""
    body = frame[columns].to_markdown(index=False)
    return body + '\n\n: {tbl-colwidths="' + str(list(widths)) + '"}\n'
```

## Where each service stands

```{python}
Markdown(section(status,
                 ['service', 'module', 'in the library', 'run', 'total (2019 USD)'],
                 [26, 24, 12, 10, 28]))
```

## What the number is, and what it is checked against

```{python}
Markdown(section(status, ['service', 'what the number is, and what it is checked against'],
                 [20, 80]))
```

## What we did to the code

```{python}
Markdown(section(status, ['service', 'what we did to the code'], [20, 80]))
```

```{python}
Markdown(section(status, ['service', 'what we need'], [22, 78]))
```
